_comment: Producer-signature CROSS-LANGUAGE byte-compat vector (Slice L1 + Slice P). The signature in `sig_b64url` was produced by the Rust daemon's `ed25519-dalek` ProducerSigner::sign_event over `producer_signing_bytes(canonical, ts, seq)`; the daemon-published verifying key is `pubkey_b64url`. Both languages re-derive the signing bytes and verify the SAME signature against the SAME key, proving the Rust producer and the TS consumer/readers hash and verify identical bytes. Consumed by server/test/castle-wall/runtime/producer-sig-cross-lang.test.ts (TS, @noble) and castle-wall-daemon/tests/integration_producer_sig_cross_lang.rs (Rust, ed25519-dalek). The keypair derives from a FIXED, non-secret seed so the vector is reproducible; it is NOT a production key. If either language's signing-bytes layout changes, this vector fails in BOTH suites.
seed_note: Ed25519 seed = bytes 1..=32 (1,2,...,32). Reproduce with castle-wall-daemon ProducerSigner::from_signing_key(SigningKey::from_bytes(&[1..=32])).
